key.name: width
key.summary: Width of the bar in pixels
key.description: Also changed by dragging the grip at the bottom-right corner.

key.name: visible-rows
key.summary: Most results shown at once
key.description: More results scroll. Also changed by dragging the grip at the bottom-right corner.

key.name: icon-size
key.summary: Size of the results' icons in pixels

key.name: font-size
key.summary: Text size in pixels
key.description: 0 uses the size of GNOME's theme.

key.name: show-descriptions
key.summary: Show a second line under each result
key.description: A file's folder, a setting's description, an open window's app.

key.name: show-source
key.summary: Show where each result comes from

key.name: highlight-color
key.summary: Highlight color
key.description: A color as #rrggbb. Empty uses the system accent color.

key.name: highlight-opacity
key.summary: Opacity of the highlight in percent

key.name: corner-radius
key.summary: Corner radius of the highlight in pixels

key.name: border-width
key.summary: Width of the highlight's light border in pixels
key.description: 0 draws no border.

key.name: focus-scale
key.summary: Size of the selected result's icon in percent
key.description: 100 turns the growth off.

key.name: panel-radius
key.summary: Corner radius of the bar in pixels

key.name: panel-opacity
key.summary: Opacity of the bar's background in percent

key.name: backdrop-opacity
key.summary: How much the screen behind the bar darkens, in percent
key.description: 0 leaves the screen as it is.

key.name: open-animation
key.summary: How the bar appears
key.description: It disappears the same way, backwards and faster.

key.name: open-duration
key.summary: Length of the opening in milliseconds
key.description: Closing takes 70% of it.

key.name: open-curve
key.summary: Speed curve of the opening

key.name: reveal-amount
key.summary: How far the bar travels when it appears
key.description: How small zoom starts, how far slide comes from, how folded unfold starts. 50 is the original look.

key.name: animation
key.summary: How the highlight moves to the selected result

key.name: animation-duration
key.summary: Length of the highlight's movement in milliseconds
key.description: Every animation follows GNOME's Animations setting: with animations off, everything is instant.

key.name: animation-curve
key.summary: Speed curve of the highlight
key.description: Not used by liquid, jelly and none, which have their own motion.

key.name: curve-rebound
key.summary: How far overshoot, bounce and elastic rebound, in percent
key.description: 50 is the usual amount; also used by the opening's curve.

key.name: stretch-reach
key.summary: Share of the stretch spent reaching over both results, in percent

key.name: liquid-viscosity
key.summary: How liquid the drop is
key.description: More: the head runs further ahead and the neck gets thinner. 50 is the original drop.

key.name: jelly-bounce
key.summary: How much the jelly bounces

key.name: jelly-wobbles
key.summary: How many times the jelly wobbles

key.name: jelly-stretch
key.summary: How much the jelly stretches while moving, in percent

key.name: pop-size
key.summary: Size pop shrinks to before jumping, in percent

key.name: animate-results
key.summary: Animate the list of results
key.description: The list grows and shrinks smoothly and new rows fade in.

key.name: search-bar-toggle
key.summary: Shortcut that opens and closes the bar

key.name: monitor
key.summary: Monitor the bar appears on

key.name: position
key.summary: Where the bar appears
key.description: Dragging the bar by its edge sets custom.

key.name: custom-x
key.summary: Horizontal place of a custom position, in percent of the free space
key.description: 0 is the left edge of the monitor, 100 the right.

key.name: custom-y
key.summary: Vertical place of a custom position, in percent of the free space
key.description: 0 is the top of the monitor, 100 the bottom.

key.name: remember-geometry
key.summary: Save the position and size changed with the mouse
key.description: Off: dragging and resizing last until the bar closes.

key.name: close-on-click-outside
key.summary: Close when clicking outside the bar

key.name: empty-query
key.summary: What the bar shows before anything is typed

key.name: results-per-source
key.summary: Most results of one source

key.name: max-results
key.summary: Most results in all

key.name: search-delay
key.summary: Wait after the last key before searching, in milliseconds
key.description: 0 searches on every key.

key.name: select-on-hover
key.summary: Select the result under the pointer

key.name: disabled-sources
key.summary: Sources whose results are not shown
key.description: applications, actions, windows, or the desktop id of one of GNOME's search providers, such as org.gnome.Nautilus.desktop.
